standard_prerequisites.name: Flat base change for cohomology of coherent sheaves

standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the cohomology of the base-changed module with the tensor product of the original cohomology.

core_obligations: Set X_{k'} = X times over Spec(k) with Spec(k') and let E_{k'} = p^*E for the projection p (proof lines 9579-9581).
Apply flat base change for cohomology to get H^i(X_{k'}, E_{k'}) = H^i(X, E) tensor_k k' and H^i(X_{k'}, O_{X_{k'}}) = H^i(X, O_X) tensor_k k' (proof lines 9582-9586).
Conclude that the Euler characteristics agree, hence that the degree is unchanged (proof lines 9587-9588).
proof_roadmap: Form the base change of the scheme and of the module.
Apply flat base change to all cohomology groups.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the degree of a locally free module E/X/k of constant rank equals the degree of its base change E_{k'}/X_{k'}/k'. The proof sets X_{k'} equal to the base change of X and E_{k'} equal to the pullback along the projection, then applies flat base change for cohomology to identify H^i(X_{k'}, E_{k'}) with H^i(X, E) tensor_k k' and similarly for the structure sheaf (proof lines 9579-9586). Since the Euler characteristics are therefore unchanged, so is the degree (proof lines 9587-9588). H2: the reduction of the claim to two flat-base-change identifications is short but complete, and the constant-rank hypothesis is exactly what the degree formula needs.
